# End-to-end integration vectors

Spec Draft 0.3.1 · vector pack GV-0.2. Each vector starts from a raw bar series (no injected ATR, trend or zones) and checks the whole chain: ATR -> swings -> trend -> zones -> pattern -> qualification -> signal -> entry, stop and target (with A-30 quantisation). `computed context` lists the intermediate values an implementation must reproduce exactly. The intermediate values were computed by a separate calculator that shares no code with the pattern engine.

#### `GV-E2E-02` · `GT-ENGULF-BULL-v1.0/SRC-CB` · H1
> End-to-end (H1, source Candlestick-Bible Engulfing): a down staircase of swing pivots gives ATR = 7613/1400 (exact; about 5.44), trend DOWN (highs 4246.40 -> 4245.20, lows 4194.00 -> 4192.80, each step larger than 0.10 x ATR), a SUPPORT zone from the two lows (last pivot a low) and a RESISTANCE zone from the two highs. The bounce up to 4210 closes ABOVE the support zone but does not kill it (a support zone dies only on a close BELOW it; the reviewer's 'either edge' rule would have killed it). The engulfing's lowest low 4193.60 is inside the support zone -> AT_SUPPORT; base formed; SRC-CB qualifies. Stop = 4193.60 - G_BUFFER (7613/28000) = 4193.3200 after quantising down; entry ask 4210.20; T_SR(2.0) = the resistance zone's near edge 47545347/11200 quantised toward the entry to 4245.12: reward 34.92 = 873/422R.
